item.text: The workspace contains only `sample.csv`, so there is no existing package contract to preserve. I’ll use a clear JSON shape: `{ "rowCount": <rows>, "means": { "<column>": <mean> } }`; a column is numeric when its non-empty data cells are finite numbers, and empty cells are excluded from that column’s mean.

Implementation and tests are in place. I’m running the automated tests plus the CLI against the provided sample and explicit failure cases; I’ll also check the executable entry point behavior before handing it off.
